Run epicrop Model Across a Weather Bundle

Source: R/run_epicrop_model.R
dot-run_bundle.Rd

Internal helper that processes a weather bundle (multiple locations or location-date combinations) by executing run_epicrop_model() separately for each bundled weather list and combining results with location labels.

Usage

.run_bundle(model_fun, emergence_dates, wth_list, window_days, output, ...)

Arguments

model_fun

Function. An epicrop model function.

emergence_dates

Vector of emergence dates (class epicrop.emerge).

wth_list

An epicrop.wth.bundle; a named list of epicrop.wth.list objects.

window_days

Integer. Days after emergence to include (default 120L).

output

Character. "audpc" or "full".

...

Additional arguments forwarded to model_fun.

Value

A data.table::data.table with results from all bundled locations combined row-wise, with an additional location column identifying the source bundle member.

Details

The function extracts location labels from the bundle's names by taking the text before the "__" delimiter (used by fetch_epicrop_weather_list()). For unnamed or empty-named entries, generates default labels (location01, location02, etc.).

Each bundled weather list is processed independently via run_epicrop_model(), then results are combined using data.table::rbindlist() with automatic column alignment.

Algorithm

  1. Extract bundle member names; generate labels for unnamed entries

  2. For each bundle member (location or location-date):

    • Call run_epicrop_model() with the sub-list

    • Add a location column to the result

  3. Combine all results via data.table::rbindlist()

See also

run_epicrop_model(), fetch_epicrop_weather_list()

Examples

# Typically called indirectly via [run_epicrop_model()] when wth_list is
# an epicrop.wth.bundle, but can be called directly:

locations <- rbind(
  "Site1" = c(121.255669, 14.16742),
  "Site2" = c(121.3, 14.2)
)
emergence <- build_epicrop_emergence(2001:2003, "-06-30")
wth_bundle <- fetch_epicrop_weather_list(
  lonlat = locations,
  start_date = "-06-30",
  duration = 120L,
  years = 2001:2003,
  mode = "cross"
)

results <- .run_bundle(
  leaf_blast,
  emergence,
  wth_bundle,
  window_days = 120L,
  output = "audpc"
)
# Results now include a 'location' column
